verdict.rationale: Luma documents reusable automations: Luma Skills ("Build a Creative Workflow Once, Run It Forever") and Agents for multi-step workflows. Nothing in the pack shows versioning, review, or rollback of those workflows. The X-API-Version policy covers the API contract, not user automations, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
